decision.reason: [ev-b5054e15ad6c] states the subject (the External Workloads feature), the change (deprecated in 1.17) and the consequence (it will be removed in v1.18). It does not say how the feature is enabled or configured, such as a Helm value, agent flag or CRD. The other items in the Deprecated Options section ([ev-21e07cf98d97], [ev-bcdbfe5ecd01], [ev-c082dfefeb1b], [ev-b7f3339817fc], [ev-9113ff586fec]) cover unrelated deprecations and don't help. To write the open applicability aspect we would need evidence, such as the External Workloads docs or the Helm values reference, that names the setting that turns the feature on.
